title: Damage/Magnetic Damage
summary: Magnetic damage and shield-disruption status effect.
extract:
Magnetic Damage is one of the six secondary elemental damage types, composed of  Cold and  Electricity elements. Deals increased damage to Corpus, Corpus Amalgam, and Techrot enemies, but reduced damage against Narmer enemies. It is particularly effective at destroying nullifier bubbles, and its Status Effect increases damage dealt to Shields and  Overguard, negates shield regeneration, and inflicts an  Electricity proc upon removing all defenses.

Status Effects

General

The status effect of  Magnetic damage is Disrupt. It amplifies damage to the Shields and  Overguard of the afflicted target by 100% and reduces natural shield regeneration for 6 seconds. Subsequent procs add 25% increased damage to Shields/Overguard up to 325% in total after 10 stacks, with each stack having their own duration. Any stacks applied after the 10th will replace the oldest stack.
Resultant Damage to Shields=Modded Damage×[2+(0.25×(Number of Magnetic Stacks−1))]

Calculating resultant damage if at least one Magnetic proc is on target. Damage Vulnerability provided by Magnetic procs are multiplicative with other damage bonuses.
Upon breaking of the Shields/Overguard the target receives a forced  Electricity proc that deals a total of 3% of the target's maximum Shields/Overguard per  Magnetic status effect, to a maximum of 30% at full stacks, over a period of 6 seconds. 
The damage of the forced  Electricity proc is determined by the weapon or ability that applied the magnetic status.

Base damage mods like  Serration mods have no effect.
Status damage mods like  Pistol Elementalist are applied twice, multiplying the damage by 3.61
Faction damage modifiers like  Expel Corpus are applied twice.
Electric damage mods like  Convulsion are applied like normal even if they are combined into another status effect.
Status duration mods are applied like normal and are a final multiplier to the total damage.
Archon Stretch Will apply when the forced electricity proc from breaking Overguard is applied but only from abilities that can apply Magnetic status
Effects that restore shields, such as  Shield Osprey's and  Orokin Drone's shield links, will bypass  Magnetic's recharge penalty.
Affected Tenno suffer additional effects: their HUDs will be distorted and have 30  Energy Drain damage dealt to them per second for 3 seconds; The first tick is dealt instantly, resulting in 4 ticks in total.  Energy Drain is dealt directly to the players energy bar, resulting in a loss of 30 energy per tick, for a total energy loss of 120 energy over the duration of the status effect. Status cleanse will stop the energy drain and the HUD static.
 Magnetic procs will show blue rings matching the shape of the affected target moving from top to bottom.

Railjack
 Magnetic does not have a Railjack space counterpart and is thus not able to proc any status effect nor is it included in calculations for status proc weighting.

Magnetic Sources
Main article: Category:Magnetic Damage

Weapons
Main article: Category:Magnetic Damage Weapons

Do also note that adversary weapons such as the  Kuva Nukor may come with a Magnetic damage benefit of up to 60% as long as the progenitor matches. In this case,  Mag would be a valid Magnetic progenitor amongst others, see the progenitor list for all valid options.

Additional Effects
Some arcanes add additional effects when a  Magnetic occurs or dealing  Magnetic damage.

Trivia
Being a combination of  Cold and Electricity, it's likely that  Magnetic is derived from superconductors, materials that conduct electricity with high efficiency at low temperature.
